notes.title: "Faith Choice: A Girl 's Bond ⚖️" Days with girlfriends: Laler&Reese is online ~
notes.content:
Days with girlfriends: Laler&Reese, developed by [Lovely Games Studios], will be available on Steam on May 23! Sign up now and start a journey of bonds with three girls ~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/431967722cc63794f2d496abf1c879b59bfcdf30.png[/img]
[h3][👇️Click to encounter three charming girls with distinct styles right away][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169830/_/
[h2]🌞 Game Background 🌞 [/h2]
In a secluded village, for millennia, a sacred commandment has been upheld — "Goddesses must keep their hearts pure to sustain divine power" 🌿.
However, in recent years, the frequent "Riss" magic outburst events have shaken the villagers' faith⚡. More strangely, when the goddess 'Larrell' revealed her arms during the ceremony, the villagers fell into a collective agitation😳… …
As the only "Assistant"🧙♂️ in the village that resonates with magic, you will be tasked with threefold missions:
[h3]✔ Assisting the goddess —— {Larrell} ✨ Rebuilding villagers' trust in their faith
✔ Help the Little Witch —— {Riss} 🌀 Master the out-of-control magic and safeguard the village's peace
✔ Facing Hunter Girl's "Invitation for Change" from {Sherry}🏹, choose to uphold tradition or embrace new trends? [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/e2c7f8b5fe45d4a1b562339ed52ffd912b7747ae.png[/img]
[code]「Change might be the only faith. 」—— Sherry's words revealed the hidden crisis in Song Village.
When ancient dogmas collide with the tide of the times, each of your choices will shape the futures of the three young girls, composing your own poem of redemption. [/code]
[h2]💟 Game Introduction💟:[/h2]
This work uses the classic three-play method🔶🔷🔶, making it easy to operate and get started with🎮. Players advance the plot by eliminating the same pattern, and each successful elimination triggers the erase effect✨ below, enhancing the immersive adventure experience!
The level difficulty will gradually increase, skillfully blending strategy with aesthetics—enjoying both fun and appreciating the interaction with beautiful girls💃, achieving two goals at once!
[code]"🗝️Not just patterns, but also the shackles of the heart❤️🔥—Are you ready to unveil the beginning of this forbidden love?" "[/code]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/0e34c2cb6f60d7efa8e512b9b03e3eb7ea47f0ef.png[/img]
💡Warm reminder: Each level has a step limit.🧮 Properly plan your elimination strategies to achieve the best gaming experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/921769b1203d1dd9044f76eb53a9fa6f1238c1f3.png[/img]
The "Reset Levels"🔁 and "One-Click Skip"⏩ functions in the upper right corner help you flexibly adjust your game rhythm!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/0eb7c14e5e0f6afbe7148481ea80ed0a0c40cd2c.png[/img]
【Settings】 and 【Exit】 buttons require pressing ESC on the keyboard to perform the operation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/6768ccddf5ea5cc1a1eb3ded5dfd8d1393a6fb01.png[/img]
After completing the level, you can revisit the beautifully unlocked visuals through the "📖Memory Album" 🎨, which features 18 plot sketches waiting for you to collect, along with hidden puzzles 🧩 and side stories to discover!

[h2]💫 Game Features💫[/h2]
[list]
[*]Multi-line Narrative · Immersive Experience: Three Teenage Girls Independent Plot Line📚, Experience Different Storylines🎭
[*]Creative Triad · Visual Feast: Fun Elimination Linked Drama Animation🎆, Strategy and Narrative Blend Perfectly
[*]Deep Character · Emotional Resonance: Fine Character Growth Trajectories💖, paired with a Dynamic Emoji Interaction System
[*]Humanized design: Built-in convenient features🛠️, achievement system🏅, and exploration elements🔍, meeting the needs of collection control and puzzle-solving parties.
[/list] 
[h2]🌸 Character Profile | Characters🌟[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/c01ee55d79c0e98bcf9ac738c03867045a28ac91.png[/img]
👑 Name: Lalier \n"Guardian of Faith and Pathfinder of Change"
Bust: 88(d)-59-85
The current goddess 🔮 guards the village ⛩️ with absolute devotion. In recent years, due to frequent magical anomalies, I have gradually become confused about my mission... …
🗨️ Perhaps divine revelation needs to come from the heart. 」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/2a783488db53eef6c3df78652a7c43db434a153b.png[/img]
🧝♀️ Name: Lis "A Innocent Magic Vessel, Seeking the Anchor of the Soul"
Bust: 92(g) - 65-85
The girl🌿, who can sense the magic of nature, has experienced multiple disasters⚡ due to emotional out-of-control. With your help, start learning to harness power with courage and reason.
🗨️ As long as you're here, I'm no longer afraid of losing control. 」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206527/d4f8d391fa3f06a190e95b12a38e0540deea6dd9.png[/img]
Name: Shirley Feld \n"Innovator Breaking Conventions"
Bust: 91(d)-62-88
Apprentice Hunter from the outside🌲 challenges the ancient dogma📜 with a pragmatic attitude. Believe that "only through change can the village survive."
🗨️ Rather than pray in chains, create the future with your own hands. 」
